Update: Nov 15th, 2026 05:19 EST 0 Share facebook twitter whatsapp Make us preferred on Google Across the United States, certain recipients of Social Security benefits are to be paid in the middle of next week , as the Social Security Administration (SSA) continues the program’s three-Wednesdays cycle for November .
 Who receives Social Security benefits on Wednesday, Nov. 18?
 Each month in the U.S., many of the Social Security scheme’s 71.7 million beneficiaries are paid on the second, third or fourth Wednesday . Under this system, a recipient’s allocated payment date depends on their birthday.
 As November 18 is the third Wednesday in the month, it’s a date that will see benefits issued to recipients born from the 11th to the 20th of any month .
 Next week’s payment run comes after a slightly ahead-of-schedule start to November’s three-Wednesdays cycle. Because the second Wednesday in the month was the Veterans Day federal holiday, beneficiaries born from the first to the 10th of any month got their November money a day earlier than usual, on Tuesday 10 .
 November’s complete three-Wednesdays cycle is:
 Born on 1st-10th of month: Tuesday, Nov. 10 
 Born on 11th-20th of month: Wednesday, Nov. 18 
 Born on 21st-31st of month: Wednesday, Nov. 25 
 NB: If you receive Social Security benefits based on someone else’s employment record, the SSA uses the other person’s birthday to determine your designated payment Wednesday.
 What other Social Security payment dates does November have?
 November 18 is the third of four payment dates on this month’s Social Security schedule. Just under two weeks ago, the SSA sent out benefits to two groups of recipients who, each month, are paid outside the three-Wednesdays cycle:
 Nov. 3: Social Security paid to double recipients and some long-term beneficiaries 
 On Tuesday 3 , November’s Social Security benefits were distributed to individuals who started receiving their monthly payments before May 1997 . Tuesday 3 was also November’s Social Security distribution date for beneficiaries who concurrently receive Supplemental Security Income (SSI).
 A needs-based benefit for certain low-income Americans , SSI is separate to the Social Security program , despite also being operated by the SSA.
 Unlike Social Security, claimants to the SSI scheme do not need to earn work credits to be eligible for monthly benefits. Worth an average of $740.07 per month, SSI was distributed for November on Friday, October 30 . 
 Social Security benefits - average monthly amounts:
 Retirement: $2,037.84 
 Disability: $1,500.84 
 Survivor: $1,636.75 
 Source: The Social Security Administration’s ‘ monthly statistical snapshot ’, published in Nov. 2026.
 How much is the 2027 COLA increase?
 In an attempt to protect beneficiaries’ purchasing power, the SSA announced last month that it is to increase Social Security and SSI amounts by 3.6% in 2027 . 
 Across all Social Security recipients, this translates into a raise of around $70 on the current average payment , which stands at $1,946.23 per month.
 How does the Social Security Admin send out benefits payments?
 Direct deposit 
 Recipients of Social Security benefits can provide the SSA with their bank details by accessing the online “ my Social Security ” tool.
 Direct Express 
 Money can be paid onto the Direct Express Card , a special debit card for recipients without a bank account. Sign up for the card at 1-800-333-1795 or 1-800-772-1213, or at a Social Security office.
